reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rationale is consistent: NOSOLICIT is a restrictive covenant we want absent, so the absence of any non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching language satisfies the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').

The cited paragraph (p0066) is an independent-contractor/no-agency clause that imposes no hiring or solicitation restriction on either party, so it does not create a covenant that would need narrowing.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the paragraph is rendered unchanged.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable heuristics here because there is no non-solicit covenant to measure, so they do not undermine the verdict.
The fallback terms are recorded as an internal note only, appropriately not raised with the counterparty.
